## Summary

Keep open. Current main does not implement publisher follows; this draft PR is the canonical base API slice for the stacked follow UI and notification PRs, but it still needs real behavior proof and small public-contract/generated-artifact fixes before merge.

## What This Changes

The PR adds a Convex publisher-follow table, public/internal follow queries and mutations, `/api/v1/publisher-follows` HTTP handlers, route constants, tests, and a follow-graph spec.

## Best Possible Solution

Land this base API only after maintainers accept the follow-graph direction, public docs/OpenAPI and committed dist artifacts are consistent, and the contributor adds redacted real HTTP/Convex proof for follow, list, and unfollow.
